question: Can a current-main, unique, disposable WSLc container use the documented digest-pinned offline/read-only local-container path on this host without inspecting or altering prior containers?

candidate.mode: foreground disposable container with unique name, CID receipt, --rm, no network, one CPU, requested 512M memory
candidate.operation: verify the frozen fixture SHA-256 and attempt one write under the read-only mount; expected errno EROFS (30)

auditor.operation: independently validate frozen source hashes, retained candidate JSON, fixture digest, EROFS, scope counters, and PASS status

cleanup.verification: targeted inspect of each exact CID from its CID file; no list or global inventory
cleanup.prior_state: do not inspect, stop, remove, or prune any pre-existing container or image

decision.pass: candidate and auditor each exit 0; frozen fixture matches; write fails with EROFS; exact CID inspection reports absent; no disallowed call occurs
decision.stop: first nonzero/ambiguous outcome or failed gate is retained; no retry and no image pull

claim_limits: no Docker comparison or general Docker compatibility claim
512M is a requested setting only; no effective limit/swap/OOM claim
no iteration-speed, memory-relief, or peak-memory claim
one host, one image digest, one CPU-only fixture and one normal-exit invocation per role
